text: Which Git command is used to record changes to the local repository with an inline descriptive message?
explanation: git commit captures a snapshot of the staged changes; the -m flag specifies the commit message inline.

text: What is the primary difference between 'git switch' and 'git checkout' introduced in Git 2.23?

options.label: A
options.text: git switch only switches branches, separating branch navigation from file restoration

options.label: B
options.text: git switch can only operate on remote tracking branches

options.label: C
options.text: git switch immediately creates a merge commit

options.label: D
options.text: git switch cannot be used when there are unstaged changes

explanation: Git 2.23 split the overloaded git checkout into git switch (branch switching) and git restore (file modification recovery).

text: When performing an interactive rebase (git rebase -i), which instruction preserves the commit's diffs while discarding its commit message into the previous commit?
explanation: The fixup instruction combines the commit diff into the previous commit while discarding the current commit's message log.

text: Which plumbing command directly generates a SHA-1 object ID for content and conditionally writes it into .git/objects?
explanation: git hash-object calculates the object ID from standard input or a file, writing the blob into the database when -w is specified.

text: How can an orphaned commit lost due to a hard reset or branch deletion be located in a local repository?

options.label: A
options.text: Inspect the local git reflog for recent HEAD reference movements

explanation: git reflog maintains local historical records of where references and HEAD have pointed, enabling commit recovery.

text: What does the Git command 'git rerere' stand for and what function does it automate?

options.label: A
options.text: Reuse Recorded Resolution: records and re-applies manual conflict resolutions

options.label: B
options.text: Rebase Recursive Repeat: repeats an aborted rebase from its reflog state

options.label: C
options.text: Remote Reference Refresh: synchronizes pruned tracking branches

options.label: D
options.text: Repository Revision Redo: rolls back unwanted clean operations

explanation: git rerere remembers how conflict hunks were manually resolved and automatically applies the identical solution to recurring conflicts.
